findings.statement: The company says its revenue is concentrated among a limited number of direct and indirect customers, and that this may continue. For fiscal year 2026 one direct customer was 22% of total revenue and another was 14%.
findings.rationale: The 10-K states the concentration directly. The tagged XBRL figures for Customer One (22.0%) and Customer Two (14.0%) match the percentages in the filing text.

quotes.text: Our revenue is concentrated among a limited number of direct and indirect customers and this trend may continue.

findings.statement: In the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 three direct customers represented 21%, 17% and 16% of total revenue.
findings.rationale: The most recent quarters show the concentration continuing, with several individual customers each above 10% of revenue. The filings do not state a combined share, so none is calculated here.

quotes.text: Direct Customers – For the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, three direct customers represented 21%, 17%, and 16% of total revenue, all of which was primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

findings.statement: For the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 one direct customer represented 16% of total revenue, and for the first half three direct customers represented 16%, 15% and 13%. In the second quarter of fiscal year 2026 two customers represented 23% and 16%.
findings.rationale: The single-customer share in the latest quarter (16%, also tagged in XBRL) is lower than in the same quarter a year earlier. Concentration is still present, but the distribution across customers has shifted. The passages do not show whether this is a trend.

quotes.text: Direct Customers – For the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, one direct customer represented 16% of total revenue, which was primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment. For the first half of fiscal year 2027, three direct customers represented 16%, 15%, and 13% of total revenue, all of which was primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

findings.statement: Accounts receivable are also concentrated: at fiscal year-end 2026, Customer One was 25%, Customer Two 18% and Customer Three 13% of receivables.
findings.rationale: The tagged receivables shares show the concentration also appears in credit exposure. These figures describe receivables, not revenue, so they support the claim only indirectly.

response.rationale: The passages support the claim. Filings across fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027 describe revenue as concentrated in a limited number of customers and give customer shares of 13% to 23%. Whether the combined share counts as large depends on the reader's threshold, which the filings do not set.
unknowns: The combined share of revenue from the largest customers is not stated, so it is not computed here.
The identities of the direct customers are not disclosed, so the passages do not show whether they are related to each other.
The indirect customer shares are described as estimates, and the passages give no figures for them.
The passages do not show whether the shift in individual customer shares in the latest quarter reflects a lasting change in concentration.
